$comment: Hand-curated Tidal reference entries, merged over the generated ones by tools/gen-tidal-ref.mjs. A value of null drops an entry.

d1.synopsis: Plays a pattern on channel 1, replacing whatever d1 was playing.
d1.description:
`d1` to `d16` each play one pattern at a time: evaluating `d1 $ …` again swaps in the new pattern on the next cycle. `d1` to `d12` also send to SuperDirt orbits 0 to 11, so each has its own effects bus. To silence one, play `silence` on it, or use `hush` to stop everything.

```haskell
d1 $ s "bd*2 [~ sn]"
```

```haskell
d2 $ n "0 .. 7" # s "arpy"
```

p.synopsis: Plays a pattern under any id, number or name, like d1.
p.description:
`p` takes an id and a pattern. `d1` is `p 1` (plus orbit 0); a name works too, which helps when patterns come and go.

```haskell
p "drums" $ s "bd*4"
```

```haskell
p "drums" silence
```

hush.description:
Stops everything that's playing, on every channel (`d1` to `d16` and any `p` ids). Uaithne's `Ctrl+.` does the same.

```haskell
hush
```

panic.synopsis: Silences everything and cuts off sounds that are still ringing.
panic.description:
Like `hush`, but also sends SuperDirt's `superpanic`, which stops long samples and synth tails at once.

```haskell
panic
```

only.synopsis: Silences everything else, then runs the given action.
only.description:
`only $ d1 $ …` hushes every other pattern and plays this one.

```haskell
only $ d1 $ s "bd*4"
```

mute.synopsis: Mutes one pattern, keeping it ready to unmute.
mute.description:
The pattern keeps running silently; `unmute` brings it back in time.

```haskell
mute 1
```

```haskell
unmute 1
```

unmute.synopsis: Unmutes a pattern that was muted with mute.

solo.synopsis: Plays only this pattern (and other soloed ones), muting the rest.
solo.description:
Undo it with `unsolo`, or `unsoloAll`.

```haskell
solo 2
```

```haskell
unsolo 2
```

once.synopsis: Plays one cycle of a pattern, once, right now.
once.description:
Handy for trying a sound without starting a loop.

```haskell
once $ s "arpy*4"
```

first.synopsis: Plays the first cycle of a pattern once.
first.description:
Unlike `once`, it plays cycle 0 rather than the current cycle.

```haskell
first $ s "<bd sn>"
```

all.synopsis: Applies a function to everything that's playing.
all.description:
`all` transforms the mix of all patterns, for example to speed everything up. `all id` puts it back.

```haskell
all $ fast 2
```

```haskell
all id
```

nudgeAll.synopsis: Shifts every pattern in time by a number of seconds.
nudgeAll.description:
Use it to line Tidal up with other gear. Positive values make Tidal later.

```haskell
nudgeAll 0.05
```

getcps.synopsis: Reads the current tempo in cycles per second.

list.synopsis: Lists the patterns that are playing, and which are muted or soloed.
